title: A reminder message for the annual stall inspection
question: Market-stall holders must book a hygiene inspection each year. Would a notice that states the deadline and the fine get more holders to book within 14 days, without raising complaints?
owner: The inspections team of Mashraq Municipal Permits Office
design_challenge: Some holders have two stalls and receive two notices. A complaint guardrail matters: the new wording is sterner.

title: A redesigned form for building-works permits
question: Would the redesigned application form raise the share of applicants who complete the application?
design_challenge: The log has one row per page view, and contractors produce about twice as many page views as owners.

title: A training programme for counter staff
question: Would two days of training for counter staff raise the share of visits resolved at the first visit?
owner: The branch services team, for its 20 service centres
design_challenge: Staff are trained centre by centre, two centres share staff, and the first wave was not chosen by chance. The pack designs the test that should be run for the second wave.
